snippet.title: Trust Your Gut - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Trust Your Gut announcement trailer for this rogue-lite roulette game. Born unlucky; your life is tied to this game. To survive, buy mementos you want, bend the odds, and return to each spin a little stronger. Trust Your Gut will be available on PC.
